pricing.title: Everything you need to grow
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade for Advanced AI when you are ready. Cancel anytime.

ai.a: Tell it what you need to do in plain language. AI turns that into organised tasks, prioritises them, breaks big goals into steps and schedules your day.

free.a: Yes. The Free plan costs $0 per month, forever, and includes all the basic tools plus community support. Upgrade only when you need more.

start.q: How fast can I get started?
start.a: In under a minute. Sign up with your email, Google or GitHub, add your first task and you are off. There is nothing to install or configure.

cancel.a: Of course. Cancel in one click or switch off auto-renew from the Billing page. No contracts, no hidden fees.

plans.q: What do I get with Premium and Pro?
plans.a: Premium adds Advanced AI and cloud storage. Pro includes everything in Premium plus priority support and a custom API.

payments.a: Payments are processed by Stripe, a global leader in secure payments. TaskFlow never sees or stores your full card number.

language.q: Can I use TaskFlow in my language?
language.a: Yes. TaskFlow is available in English and Ukrainian, in both light and dark themes. Switch any time in Settings.
